hypothesis: A fixed half-weight combination of existing Ridge and recovered HGB endpoint predictions may have lower matched development error than either unchanged base prediction.
material_difference: The blend is a deterministic two-model diagnostic, not a new base learner, selected weight, calibrated forecast, ranker, policy, or economic result.

population.unsupported_targets: retain explicit missing-label or coverage reason; do not substitute session targets

causal_rules.blend: 0.5 * ridge_prediction + 0.5 * recovered_hgb_prediction only when both source rows and their model/readiness identities match exactly
causal_rules.outcome_rules: outcome is assessment-only and cannot enter original blend payload; reject an outcome available after assessment_asof or before its label_end_epoch

metrics.primary: row-weighted paired MAE delta of blend against each unchanged base on identical mature paired support
metrics.uncertainty: descriptive contiguous origin moving-block sensitivity for block lengths 4, 8, 20 with 2000 replicates and seed 20260922; insufficient support returns explicit no_interval
metrics.dependence_limit: shared currencies, overlapping horizons and short inspected development period prohibit effective-N, p-values, winner labels and confirmation

outcomes.positive: Record observed negative paired MAE deltas without calling a winner or improvement confirmation.
outcomes.negative: Record all declared comparator results without retuning.
outcomes.inconclusive: Retain missing support, insufficient blocks, mixed comparators and all unavailable labels.
outcomes.economic: Not assessed; endpoint error alone has no cost/risk/financing/fill interpretation.
